name: Downtown Disney Naples Ristorante e Bar Spaghetti with Olive Oil/Chicken or Light Mozzarella Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Naples Ristorante e Bar (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Naples uses long-fermented authentic Caputo "00" Italian wheat flour for its wood-fired pizza crust and will gladly prepare penne/spaghetti simply with extra-virgin olive oil, grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken breast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Spaghetti or Penne with Olive Oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and Grilled Chicken (no red marinara or chili flakes), or share a White/Margherita Pizza with a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Take lactase if ordering fresh mozzarella pizza, and skip spicy pepperoni/calabrian chili toppings
